[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Generet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Destabilization]] branch. He allowed his appearance to be surgically altered so that he resembled a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and participated in the [[Calamari Project]], an effort incite war between the Mon Calamari and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].
